== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Wookiee Guide (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (GEMP <code>2250_68</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text: the errata of 13 April 2013 that added “(as if just lost)”, rescinded on 15 April 2013. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-68-Wookiee_Guide.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-wookieeguide-pre.gif]]) print the original text ([[Wookiee Guide (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee rules forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post of 13 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574#p802181 forum post]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p802181 Internet Archive]); rescinded 15 April 2013. Text as posted (“Reserve deck”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Stack a Wookiee (as if just lost) from your Lost Pile on Grrrghrrrgh!. OR Deploy a Wookiee stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! to Kashyyyk (as if from hand). OR Once per game, draw X cards from top of Reserve deck, where X = number of cards stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1250_68</code>: Decipher art of Wookiee Guide, title, lore, Endor sphere, slip 68, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. The Episode I disc was moved by hand from the icon column to the lower right of the text box, where the slip and the Players Committee card image print it (CardMaker places it in the upper column). Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
